programs.title: Environmental heat and health tour
programs.description: Profiles twelve synthetic observations, describes heat categories, compares the binary heat and health-event indicators, and produces a chart without claiming causal inference.
programs.source:
*** Epi Info AI environmental epidemiology teaching candidate
*** All records and exposure values are synthetic. This program does not estimate causality.

HEADER 1 "Environmental heat and health teaching workflow"
TYPEOUT "Review data quality, describe the synthetic exposure, compare health-event counts, and open the project point layer in Maps."

READ [Synthetic Heat Health Observations Form]
EPIAI QUALITY *
LIST observation_id observation_date study_area heat_index_c extreme_heat health_event
FREQ heat_category
MEANS heat_index_c
TABLES extreme_heat health_event
GRAPH heat_category GRAPHTYPE="Bar" TITLETEXT="Synthetic observations by heat category" XTITLE="Heat category" YTITLE="Observations"

TYPEOUT "These descriptive results demonstrate a governed workflow; they are not an exposure model or health-effect estimate."
